notes: Scenarios show their goal and your progress at all times (#34): a card at the top of the Goals tab breaks the goal into steps with progress bars and shows the days left. The top bar on desktop, and the Goals tab on phones, show how far you are.
Your customer level is always visible too: a card in the Goals tab shows what the next level unlocks and how close you are to it, and the Rank box shows your level.
The NOC dashboard has tabs: Overview, Customers, Connections, Traffic and Links & routers, so you no longer scroll through everything at once.
The share card draws links that cross the Pacific on both edges of the map (#42).
